connector.name: Agent Demand
connector.registryDescription: Economic-intent network for AI agents to publish demand and discover services.
connector.summary: Hosted at agentdemand.network over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace network.agentdemand, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for constrained Agent Demand evaluation access. Obtain a short-lived evaluation key from https://agentdemand.network/v1/evaluation-keys before connecting.
